note: émission du 1 novembre 2021 de 1 Md$ d'obligations senior 2,703 % échéant en 2032 ; porteurs non nommés
quote: On November 1, 2021, Micron Technology, Inc. ("Micron") settled its offering of $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 2.703% senior notes due 2032 (the "Green Bonds"), $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.366% senior notes due 2041 (the "2041 Notes"), and $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.477% senior notes due 2051 (the "2051 Notes," together with the Green Bonds and the 2041 Notes, the "Notes")
